title: Patient-Requested Cancellations of In-Person Appointments
content:
## Rule

A patient may cancel an open In-Person Appointments visit at any time before check-in, and the cancellation is recorded with its timing class. A request to cancel a visit in order to rebook it is recorded as a cancellation of this visit with the timing class this rule gives, followed by a new booking, never as a reschedule. A patient may move an open visit to another slot of the same visit type only while a cancellation of the visit recorded on the same day would be timely under this rule; the move keeps the encounter number and the status. A cancellation made by the clinic is outside this rule and is recorded as clinic initiated.

| Request from the patient | How it is recorded |
|---|---|
| Cancel an open visit before check-in | A cancellation of that visit, with its timing class |
| Cancel in order to rebook | A cancellation of that visit with its timing class, then a new booking; never a reschedule |
| Move to another slot of the same visit type | A move, allowed only while a same-day cancellation of the visit would be timely; encounter number and status kept |

## The cancellation tool

**Capability.** `cancel_patient_appointment_f57629ba` cancels one open in-person appointment at the patient's own request and records the timing class of the cancellation. The appointment moves to status cancelled with reason `patient_request`; the moment of cancellation is stamped as the current time, the visit's closed date becomes today, and the timing class supplied is stored on the appointment exactly as given. Nothing else changes: any booking deposit held on the visit stays recorded on it, and no fee, waiver or refund entry is written.

**Invocation.** The tool is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `cancel_patient_appointment_f57629ba` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| `appointment_id` | Reference number of the in-person appointment being cancelled, read from the appointment list returned by the appointment lookup for this patient | Identifier |
| `cancel_timing` | The timing class the cancellation carries under the cancellation rules | One of `not_cancelled`, `timely`, `late`, `clinic_initiated` |

The values of `cancel_timing` mean: `not_cancelled`, the class a visit carries while it has not been cancelled, never the class of a cancellation being recorded; `timely`, the patient gave at least the notice the visit requires; `late`, the patient gave less notice than the visit requires; `clinic_initiated`, the clinic, not the patient, cancelled the visit, which never applies to a cancellation made at the patient's request.

**Return.** A receipt with `appointment_id` (the cancelled visit), `status` (always "cancelled" on success), `cancel_reason` (always `patient_request`), `cancel_timing` (the class stored), `cancelled_at` (the timestamp of the cancellation as the system clock reports it) and `closed_date` (the date the visit closed, YYYY-MM-DD). A status of "cancelled" confirms the cancellation is recorded; afterwards the appointment list shows the visit as cancelled with that timing.
